summary: An OMP channel no longer exits when the daemon stops just after the channel says hello. A daemon that is stopping can answer the channel's incarnation read with an error, not only drop the connection, and that error ended the channel; it is now logged and read again later, as an outage is

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Only the channel's first incarnation read after its hello changes: an error answer is logged to the driver warnings log and leaves todo publishing suspended until the next minute's read, as a mismatched incarnation already did.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

recovery.detail: No persistent state; an older build only reintroduces the exit.
